name: How does the insurance claims process work with City Dweller, LLC?

mainEntity.name: How does the insurance claims process work with City Dweller, LLC?

acceptedAnswer.text: With City Dweller, LLC, the insurance claims process for interior restoration begins with a thorough assessment of your property damage. We document all affected areas and prepare a detailed estimate for the necessary repairs. This estimate is then submitted directly to your insurance company. We communicate closely with your insurance adjuster, providing all required information and advocating for a fair settlement that covers the full scope of work. Our goal is to minimize your stress by managing the entire claims communication and approval process.
acceptedAnswer.description: We assess damage, prepare an estimate, submit it to your insurer, and manage communication with your adjuster to ensure repairs are covered.
